name: @waste/worker
description: The pg-boss worker (Issue #97 part B, ADR-0007): the second Node process on the database, on which the jobs the contexts owe run — Planning's generation and its nightly plan-ahead, Execution's outbox relay, Resolution's and Finance's consumers of it. This package is the process and the registry the jobs plug into: pg-boss 12 booted on the worker role's session connection with `migrate: false` (the owner installed schema `pgboss` in migration 0011), every job of `src/jobs/index.ts` given its queue, its worker and, where it recurs, its cron schedule; GET /healthz (liveness) and GET /readyz (readiness: pg-boss started and the database answering, with the count of failed jobs) on its own port for the host's probe; and one job, `worker.heartbeat`, as the proof the wiring works.
